Create two synthetic active BrandTemplate records with distinct names and developer names; sort their IDs. Create three EmailTemplate records in a scratch-user folder with distinct names and developer names and Encoding=UTF-8. The null case uses TemplateType=custom and TemplateStyle=none. The two populated cases use TemplateType=html, an active non-none TemplateStyle from describe, and lower or higher BrandTemplateId. Re-query all values and label records N, L, H. At each API version query them with ORDER BY BrandTemplateId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST. No email is sent.
